hits.snippet: top of page # FriskAI Launches the Runtime Intelligence Platform for AI Agents, Announces $3.6 Million Pre-Seed Funding Round * Writer: Karan Bhatia Karan Bhatia * 3 days ago * 2 min read [FriskAI](https://www.friskai.com/) , the runtime intelligence platform for AI agents, led by Neel Palrecha and the team, has announced its official launch and a $3.6 million pre-seed funding round led by [MaC Venture Capital](https://macventurecapital.com/) , with participation from [Wischoff Ventures](https://www.wischoff.com/) , NEA partner Rick Yang, and a group of strategic angel investors. FriskAI sits between AI agents and the tools they use, capturing every action taken by an agent. The platform gives organizations visibility into agent behavior, enabling teams to understand how agents operate, detect unexpected activity, investigate incidents, and deploy AI more confidently across critical workflows.
